caption: The drawing depicts an orange-brown bonnet with a rounded crown and a brim that extends forward and curves slightly upward. The bonnet is adorned with a large, light beige bow and ribbon that wraps around the crown and ties at the side, with two long, narrow ribbon ends hanging down. Along the edge of the brim is a pleated, translucent, light gray trim that adds a delicate border to the bonnet. The overall composition focuses solely on the bonnet, with no additional objects or background elements present. The drawing uses subtle shading to suggest the three-dimensional form and fabric texture, and the outlines are softly rendered in pencil, while the colors are applied in a restrained, muted palette.
title: Bonnet
